repair.title: Cluster Munition Stockpiles Shrunk
repair.summary: Cluster Munition Monitor says 42 States Parties destroyed all declared stocks, including 179 million submunitions.
repair.why_it_matters: Destroying stockpiles prevents weapons that can harm civilians long after fighting ends from being used later.
repair.caveat: Not all countries have joined the treaty, and cluster munitions are still used in conflicts.
